title: One-step output complementation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state oracle Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $O$ be an oracle language, let $x$ be an input bit string, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. One step of the machine whose ordinary transition outputs are complemented, starting from the configuration whose existing output bits are complemented, equals the configuration obtained by taking one step of $M$ with oracle $O$ from $c$ and then complementing every output bit.
hypotheses_covered: Finite-state oracle Turing machine over Boolean symbols
